claim: Aire-sur-l'Adour holds its weekly market on Tuesdays AND Saturdays, 8h00–12h30, under Les Halles on Place du Commerce, with about 50 vendors covering bakers, butchers, fishmongers, produce, cheese and wines.
quote: Le marché alimentaire d'Aire sur l'Adour est ouvert les mardis et samedis toute l'année, de 08h00 à 12h30 ... Une cinquantaine de commerçants ... boulangers, bouchers, poissonniers, maraîchers

claim: Saint-Sever's Saturday morning market on Place et Rue du Tribunal features cheesemongers, charcutiers, butchers, fishmongers, pastry shops plus small farm producers selling foie gras, duck, poultry, cheeses, pork and honey.
quote: dans les halles et alentour : fromagers, charcutiers, bouchers, poissonniers, pâtissiers, et de petits producteurs fermiers de foie gras et canard, volailles, primeurs, fromages, porc et miel

claim: From October to April, marchés au gras (fat markets) are essential rendezvous around the Adour valley and Chalosse, the historical foie gras stronghold, with Amou, Geaune, Hagetmau and Saint-Sever hosting open-air duck farms and producer visits.
quote: D'octobre à avril, les marchés au gras dans les Landes sont des rendez-vous incontournables ... autour d'Amou, Geaune, Hagetmau et Saint-Sever, les producteurs sont heureux de faire découvrir aux visiteurs leur élevage de canards

claim: Hagetmau holds its traditional market every Wednesday and Saturday from 8h to 13h on Place Charles De Gaulle, with regional specialties and a summer evening Marché des Producteurs de Pays.
quote: Tous les mercredis et samedis de 8h à 13h ... Place Charles De Gaulle

claim: Grenade-sur-l'Adour hosts producer markets on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday mornings (9h–12h), with Saturday adding takeaway food and Wednesday adding textiles; Le Vignau also runs a Wednesday producer market.
quote: Monday morning (9am-12pm): Producer markets; Wednesday morning (9am-12pm): Producer and textile markets; Saturday morning (9am-12pm): Producer markets and takeaway food

claim: Maison Dubernet, founded 1864 in Saint-Sever, makes hand-crafted foie gras, terrines and confits from IGP Sud-Ouest ducks sourced from a small group of Saint-Sever breeders, with a factory shop open Mon–Thu 8–12 / 14–17 and Fri 8–15, and a first-Friday-of-the-month open house with 15–20% off.
quote: Maison Dubernet, founded in 1864 in the heart of the Landes ... factory shop in Saint-Sever is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 12pm and 2pm to 5pm ... On the first Friday of each month, there are open houses with an average 15 to 20% discount

claim: Maison Lafitte's Montaut boutique at 455 route du Béarn sits on the production site and opens Mon–Fri 8h–12h30 / 13h30–17h (closed weekends), sourcing ducks from small Landes farms within a 40 km radius fed non-GMO whole grain corn.
quote: 455 route du Béarn, 40500 Montaut ... Monday-Friday: 8:00 AM - 12:30 PM & 1:30 PM - 5:00 PM ... ducks come from small agricultural operations in the Landes within a 40 km radius

claim: Maison Lafitte (Montaut) has worked since 1920 exclusively with ~80 local farms within a 40 km radius and is 100% Label Rouge and IGP Sud-Ouest, with Mulard ducks raised at least 102 days outdoors and fattened on whole grain corn.
quote: 100% certifié Label Rouge et IGP Sud-Ouest ... canard gras élevé pendant minimum 102 jours et gavé au maïs grain entier ... petites exploitations agricoles des Landes situées à moins de 40 km

claim: Ferme Parlariou at Gamarde-les-Bains offers afternoon farm visits by appointment showing the gavage and outdoor duck rearing, plus Blonde d'Aquitaine cattle, with on-site sale of foie gras, confits, pâtés and beef.
quote: Gamarde-les-Bains, 491 route de Mouréou (2 km from Montfort-en-Chalosse) ... ducks, cattle (Blonde d'Aquitaine breed) ... Duck products including fresh fattened ducks, foie gras, preserved items, pâtés, sausages

claim: Parlariou afternoon farm tours are by phone appointment, weather-permitting, at 6€ per adult and 3€ per child (5–15), ending with a free tasting of the producer's foie gras and beef-veal preparations.
quote: sur rendez-vous par téléphone et selon les conditions météo, les après-midi, pour un tarif de 6 € par adulte et 3 € par enfant ... Un moment de dégustation vous sera offert à l'issue de la visite

claim: The Cave des Vignerons de Tursan at Geaune runs guided cellar visits every Tuesday at 10h and 14h30 from May through end of August, ending with a tasting of Tursan and Landes wines for 5€ per adult (registration 05 58 44 51 25).
quote: Tous les mardis de mai à fin août, à 10h et 14h30 ... 5€ par personne (à partir de 18 ans). Inscription au 05 58 44 51 25

claim: Geaune is a 1318 bastide whose cooperative wine cellars welcome visitors April–October to introduce Tursan winemaking, in a region also known for Samadet faïence pottery.
quote: Geaune is a bastide of great character created in 1318 ... cooperative wine cellars welcome visitors from April to October and introduce visitors to the art of Tursan winemaking

claim: The Musée départemental de la Faïence et des Arts de la table at Samadet preserves the legacy of the 1732 royal pottery manufactory with over 300 decorated pieces and contemporary ceramics in the adjoining Maison de la Céramique.
quote: manufacture royale de faïence ... établie dans le petit village de Samadet en 1732 ... Plus de 300 pièces de faïence de Samadet

claim: Saint-Sever's En Direct de nos Producteurs boutique aggregates Landes producers (Sarrade, Delpeyrat partners) selling foie gras, magret, confit, prepared dishes, Label Rouge or organic poultry, smoked salmon, Bayonne ham and Pyrenean pork with full traceability.
quote: spécialités du sud-ouest ... canards (foie gras, magret, confit, plats cuisinés et pâtés gourmands), volailles Label Rouge ou bio des Landes, saumon fumé, jambon de Bayonne et porc des Pyrénées

claim: The IGP Canard à Foie Gras du Sud-Ouest covers Chalosse, Gascogne, Gers, Landes, Périgord and Quercy and guarantees that duck foie gras is raised, fattened and processed entirely within the South-West region.
quote: IGP Canard à Foie Gras du Sud-Ouest (covering Chalosse, Gascogne, Gers, Landes, Périgord, Quercy) ... ducks raised, fattened and cooked in the region
